pr_title: Fix skipping events on resume handshake

issue_context.title: Orleans streaming with Event Hubs skips over messages when stream is inactive
issue_context.body:
### Problem description
Given
- `MetadataMinTimeInCache` is set to a large value (so it is not purged)
- The last message for a stream has been purged from the cache.
- The grain is active
- The stream is INACTIVE

When a new message is available, then **it is not delivered to the grain.**

This does not seem to happen if `MetadataMinTimeInCache` is set to a small value that garantees it is purged. However, a QueueCacheMissException is raised in this case, which is expected I suppose.

This is similar to [this issue](https://github.com/dotnet/orleans/issues/9023), but specific to Event Hubs instead of Memory Streams.
This is similar to [this issue](https://github.com/dotnet/orleans/issues/9297), except that metadata cache is enabled.

### Expected outcome
The message should be delivered to the grain.

### Reproduction project
https://github.com/Costo/orleans-streams-skip-messages-again
